messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Turkish, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Turkish line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Nasıl girdiğimi iyi anlatamıyorum, O noktada öyle çok uykudaydım ki gerçek yolu terk ettiğim noktada.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|-----------------------|--------| | Io | 1st‑person singular pronoun (subject) | — (implicit) | I (understood in verb) | UNNECESSARY | | non | negation particle | — (encoded in verb suffix *‑ma‑*) | not | UNNECESSARY | | so | verb *sapere* “to know” (present) | — (encoded in verb *anlatamıyorum*) | know | UNNECESSARY | | ben | adverb “well” | **iyi** | well | OK | | ridir | infinitive “to recount / tell again” | **anlatamıyorum** | (I) cannot recount | OK | | com' | interrogative adverb “how” | **Nasıl** | how | OK | | i' | clitic pronoun “I” inside the clause | — (implicit) | I (understood) | UNNECESSARY | | v'intrai | past historic “I entered (it)” | **girdiğimi** | (that) I entered | OK | | tant' | degree adverb “so, such” | **öyle** | so | OK | | era | imperfect “was” (copular) | — (encoded in *uykudaydım*) | was | UNNECESSARY | | pien | adjective “full, very” | **çok** | very | OK | | di | preposition “of” (linking *pien* to *sonno*) | — (implicit) | of | UNNECESSARY | | sonno | noun “slumber, sleepiness” | **uyku** (part of *uykudaydım*) | sleep | OK | | a | preposition “at” (temporal) | — (implicit) | at | UNNECESSARY | | quel | demonstrative “that” | **O** | that | OK | | punto | noun “point, moment” | **noktada** | point (locative) | OK | | che | relative conjunction “where” | — (implicit in *noktada*) | where | UNNECESSARY | | la | definite article “the” (feminine) | — (articles omitted in Turkish) | the | UNNECESSARY | | verace | adjective “true, correct” | **gerçek** | true | OK | | via | noun “way, path” | **yolu** | way (accusative) | OK | | abbandonai | past historic “I abandoned” | **terk ettiğim** | (that) I abandoned | OK |

### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY** (omitted because Turkish does not require them): Io, non, so, i', era, di, a, che, la. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected; the Turkish rendering respects the source meaning and grammatical conventions.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Turkish script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Turkish text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
